additional_info.subject: RE: ID0462595-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multi] Firmware Update CRM:03098000200
additional_info.body:
Dear Giuseppe,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0462595.
The ticket was opened some weeks ago, for issues to roll out the FW to some chargers in Portonaccio Depot, even if the Hawkbit.conf file was present in the configuration files of the charger.
I asked R&D to take a look at the connectivity of the chargers, but nothing abnormal was detected. According to R&D, it seems that these chargers have a week bandwidth.
Over the past weeks and days, I managed to rollout the FW during nights and update the reported chargers to v8.0.5. Only two chargers need your onsite support:
MP/T1170004363
, to this charger I rolled out the FW and updated twice, but the charger never booted in the new FW. I asked R&D to take a look into it, and they told me that it seems the CFAST is not able to access the other partition. R&D tried to manually force the boot to the other partition, and now the charger is offline.
Most likely, the CFAST card is corrupted, according to R&D, and they suggest to replace the CFast card on this charger.
It is necessary to please go onsite and restore this charger. I attach the config files to this email for your convenience.
On charger
MP/T2170004366
I am not able to rollout manually the FW. I tried to let the FW rollout go for 2 nights, but the connection is incredibly slow and eventually it blocked. For this charger, I would recommend to perform a USB update onsite (or a CFast card flashing if easier for you).
Since an onsite visit is required form your side, I would proceed to move
the case
0462595
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-IT SI E Queue
. Please let us know if you need further support for the onsite activity, so that we can schedule the activity in advance.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
